items.title: Konitz Lee — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He actually talked to Peter Bartok to kind of get permission.

ctx.x: I just listened to that the other day after not having it in ages. Whose idea was it to do the three things from the “Mikrokosmos’’?
Marshall Brown. He actually talked to Peter Bartok to kind of get permission. He said “fine”. He couldn’t care less. I don’t know how Bela would’ve felt about that.

“Village Joke” is my favorite of those three. Do you remember that? That’s the one where each of you plays a solo “solo”. Each of you plays alone after playing the theme. But that’s my favorite of those.
